# woff2 / convert_woff2ttf_fuzzer_new_entry

woff2's own fuzz target `convert_woff2ttf_fuzzer_new_entry` ([source](source/convert_woff2ttf_fuzzer_new_entry.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over woff2 (google/woff2 at fb9c3379).

woff2::ConvertWOFF2ToTTF into a WOFF2StringOut (30 MiB cap / sized from ComputeWOFF2FinalSize); the boolean result and the TTF bytes are discarded (no re-encode or checksum comparison by the harness).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against woff2 at commit fb9c3379.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
